items.title: Amphenol (APH) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: Amphenol is back in focus after analysts raised their fair value estimate from US$184.78 to US$189.39, pointing to a slightly higher price target framework for the stock. This shift lines up with recent research that clusters higher price targets around the Q2 earnings preview, as analysts weigh Amphenol’s roles in networking infrastructure, storage components, and AI related demand against execution and positioning risks. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative might matter...
